text: Over the 276 sessions to 11 Sep 26, the correlation between bitcoin's daily returns and the Nasdaq Composite's was 0.38 across the last 90 sessions. Against the Nasdaq over 252 sessions the beta is 1.14 with an R² of 0.23, so the index accounts for about 23% of the variance in bitcoin's daily returns. This is a description of the figures, not advice.
